issues.description: Clarified that the recipe reheats fully cooked ready-to-eat karaage; it does not use a short fry step to cook raw chicken. Text review covered the final zh-TW, en, ja, and ko article bodies. Recipe time, yield, and sensory results still require kitchen verification; no trial evidence or restaurant provenance is claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Have a cook prepare the recipe as written, record actual prep and cook time and yield, confirm texture and applicable safe internal temperatures, then update the article before reconsidering indexing.
